# YiQi Medical Group 益氣堂

> Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) clinic in San Carlos, California. Five licensed TCM doctors offer acupuncture, fertility support, Tui Na massage and Acu-Facial. PPO insurance accepted; benefits are verified before the first visit. A $60 community acupuncture clinic runs Mondays 3–6 pm (everyone) and Thursdays 10 am–6 pm (seniors 65+), pay per visit, no package. The website is available in English and Traditional Chinese.

Address: 555 Old County Road, Suite 100, San Carlos, CA 94070
Phone: 650-788-9818
Email: yiqimedicalgroup@gmail.com
Book online: https://yiqi.janeapp.com/

## Key pages
- [$60 Community Clinic](https://www.yiqimedicalgroup.com/community-clinic): schedule, what is included, how to book
- [Acupuncture](https://www.yiqimedicalgroup.com/acupuncture): private acupuncture, $150 per session, PPO accepted
- [Fertility acupuncture](https://www.yiqimedicalgroup.com/fertility-acupuncture): support alone or alongside IUI/IVF
- [Tui Na massage](https://www.yiqimedicalgroup.com/tui-na-massage): 60 minutes, $120 or 5 sessions for $500, no needles
- [Acu-Facial](https://www.yiqimedicalgroup.com/acu-facial): facial and body acupuncture for skin
- [Our doctors](https://www.yiqimedicalgroup.com/our-team): Dr. Amy Wang, Prof. Kevin Yen, Dr. Kate Chen, Dr. Phyu Phyu Thin, Dr. Miles Ronkos
- [FAQ](https://www.yiqimedicalgroup.com/faq): cost, insurance, first visit, needles, fertility
- [TCM dietetics](https://www.yiqimedicalgroup.com/dietetics) and [Zi Wu Liu Zhu body clock](https://www.yiqimedicalgroup.com/zi-wu-liu-zhu)
- [Medical Tai-Chi with Sifu Donna](https://www.yiqimedicalgroup.com/tai-chi)
- [Contact](https://www.yiqimedicalgroup.com/contact)
